sentences.text: Stephanie Lynn `` Stevie '' Nicks -LRB- born May 26 , 1948 -RRB- is an American singer-songwriter who is often regarded as the Queen of Rock n ' Roll .	Rock	Rock music
Nicks is best known for her work as the front-woman of Fleetwood Mac and for her chart-topping solo career .	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac
She is known for her distinctive voice , mystical visual style , and symbolic lyrics .

Collectively , her work both as a member of Fleetwood Mac and as a solo artist has produced over 40 top-50 hits and sold over 140 million records , making her one of the best selling music acts of all time with Fleetwood Mac .	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac	best selling music acts of all time	List of best-selling music artists

Her influence in fashion , music and musical performance is widely acknowledged ; and as such , she has been named one of music 's top 55 `` Greatest Songwriters of All Time '' , and as one of the world 's top `` 100 Greatest Singers of All Time '' by Rolling Stone .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone
As a member of Fleetwood Mac , she was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1998 .	Rock	Rock music	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
She has garnered eight Grammy Award nominations and two American Music Award nominations as a solo artist .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	American Music Award	American Music Award
She has won numerous awards with Fleetwood Mac , including a Grammy Award and five Grammy Award nominations .	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac	Grammy Award	Grammy Award
Nicks joined Fleetwood Mac in 1975 along with her then boyfriend , Lindsey Buckingham .	Lindsey Buckingham	Lindsey Buckingham	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac

Rumours , Fleetwood Mac 's second album after the incorporation of Nicks and Buckingham , was the best-selling album of the year of its release , and to date , has made sales of over 40 million copies worldwide , making it the fifth-highest selling studio album of all time .	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac	Rumours	Rumours (album)	fifth-highest selling studio album of all time	List of best-selling albums
The album remained at number one on the American albums chart for 31 weeks and reached Number One in various countries worldwide .
The album won the Grammy Award for Album of the Year in 1978 .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Grammy Award for Album of the Year	Grammy Award for Album of the Year
it produced four U.S. top-10 singles , with Nicks ' `` Dreams '' being the band 's first and only U.S. number-one hit .	Dreams	Dreams (Fleetwood Mac song)

In 1981 , while remaining a member of Fleetwood Mac , Nicks began her solo career , releasing the album Bella Donna , which topped the Billboard album charts and reached platinum status less than three months after its release , and has since been certified quadruple-platinum .	Fleetwood Mac	Fleetwood Mac	Bella Donna	Bella Donna (album)	platinum	RIAA certification
She has released a total of eight solo studio albums to date , with her most recent titled 24 Karat Gold : Songs from the Vault , released in October 2014 .
During her solo career , she has had a close working relationship with Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers .	Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers	Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers
They served as a backing band for several tracks on each of her solo albums , and the two have toured and performed together frequently over the past three decades .
The song `` Stop Draggin ' My Heart Around '' , performed by Nicks and Petty , was one of the biggest hits for either artist .
